title: Randomized second order Riesz projections on the Hamming cube
summary: In this paper, we improve the arbitrary Banach space \(n \log n\) bound of Ivanisvili--Volberg \cite{IvanisviliVolberg2022} for the second order projection bound to the order \(\sqrt{n}\) bound. Moreover, we study the lower Riesz estimate with the pointwise square gradient, and prove a fixed chaos characterization: on every fixed homogeneous Walsh chaos $H_k$, the dimension free estimate \[ \|Δ^{1/2}f\|_{L^p(Ω_n;X)} \lesssim_{p,k,X} \||\nabla f|_X\|_{L^p(Ω_n)} \] holds for all $n$ if and only if $X$ has Rademacher type $2$.
